title: CrowdStrike Policy Version Label Conflation (v3 vs v1)
reported_in_2_6c: CrowdStrike Policy v3 inverted burden of proof ('without approved IT ticket -> TP')
authoritative_finding: The active approved policy in the persistent SQLite database is PromptVersion 'bd751fac-9bfb-4994-b150-8850bb94dd6c' with version_number = 1. The execution ledger correctly recorded policy_version = 1 and policy_content_hash = fe1c4184cc5b8f020ee006c8175ba0144b0e82ba246b29a752490748e0ad65cc. The 2.6c report conflated the PolicyCompilerService compiler version ('v3.0.0') and the hardcoded fallback definition ('version_number=3') with the actual database prompt version.
reconciliation_action: Correct report references to reflect Prompt Version 1 (compiled via PolicyCompilerService v3.0.0). Retain cryptographic linkage to ledger hash fe1c4184cc5b.

title: Identity Inversion Between Incident 132591888 and Incident 132596403
reported_in_2_6c: In AIS 2.6c docs 11, 13, 15, and 20, incident 132596403 was referred to as 'update.exe' and incident 132591888 as 'review.es.system.js' or web tracking script.
authoritative_finding:
Authoritative database records and original raw zip telemetry conclusively prove:
- Incident 132591888 is Windows PE executable 'update.exe' (appCategory=remote-access, source_ip=172.25.6.208).
- Incident 132596403 is JavaScript asset 'review.es.system.js' (appCategory=travel, source_ip=172.25.6.101).
reconciliation_action: Reconciled all metadata registers, manifests, and documentation to strictly match authoritative telemetry.

title: Promotion of Historical Operational Text to VERIFIED_FP Without Human Review
reported_in_2_6c: Execution ledgers in Mode A, B, and C labeled incidents 132474210 and 132499009 as VERIFIED_FP, despite zero human reviews having been performed.
authoritative_finding: HistoricalGroundTruthValidator.adjudicate_label() automatically mapped Level 1 historical FortiSIEM closure comments containing 'False Positive' to GroundTruthLabel.VERIFIED_FP. In reality, zero Level 2 independent human reviews had been submitted in Verdictum AI. No Level 3 corroboration or Level 4 formal certification existed.
reconciliation_action: Demoted all unreviewed historical labels from VERIFIED_FP/TP to LEVEL_1_HISTORICAL_OPERATIONAL (UNVERIFIED for live empirical accuracy evaluation). Formally enforce that only Level 2/3/4 human reviews submitted through the Review workspace can serve as verified ground truth for empirical benchmarking.

title: Speculative Numerical Attribution of Model Proposal Bias
reported_in_2_6c: Informal attributions such as '50% policy directive bias, 30% evidence omission, 10% prompt compiler bias'.
authoritative_finding: These numerical percentages were heuristic estimates without counterfactual experimental measurement. Attributing exact percentage fractions to interconnected prompt components without controlled single-variable ablation is scientifically unsound.
reconciliation_action: Removed all arbitrary numerical causal percentages. Replaced with rigorous qualitative hypothesis classifications (H1 to H7) and established controlled single-variable live experiments.

title: Passage of Live Empirical Gates on Offline Simulation Evidence
reported_in_2_6c: 32 of 33 acceptance gates were marked PASS in AIS 2.6c, including live inference and model evaluation gates, even though all executions were offline simulations (execution_provenance = OFFLINE_SIMULATION).
authoritative_finding: Live GPU Server 2 was unreachable (timeout at http://13.204.214.64:8000/v1). While offline deterministic simulations proved pipeline wiring and guardrail logic, gates specifying live empirical model capability cannot pass on simulation evidence alone.
reconciliation_action: Reclassified all gates dependent on live GPU inference and human ground truth to BLOCKED_GPU_UNAVAILABLE or BLOCKED_PENDING_HUMAN_REVIEW until actual live execution occurs.
